Hi, Yoshio.
I want to thank you for speaking on behalf of the product development teams.
Are you pleased with the budget increase?
Certainly.
You know, it's great that with this increase, we'll be able to poll consumers and do more market research.
You're right.
Heading the budget committee was more work than I thought it would be.
I'm glad the position rotates annually and next year it will be someone else's turn.

当然。

你说得对。
担任预算委员会主席比我想象的要辛苦。
我很高兴这个职位每年轮换一次，明年就会是别人的回合了。
